title: Paloma and the Verdict
author: Oscar Nystrom
blurb: Vesper Nystrom, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
